{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id entries
print(f'Number of rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
df_sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print(f'Patient_id with max sample_seq: {df_sample_seq_max.shape[0]}')

# Check if all patient_id appear more than once? (i.e., are there re-tests?)
df_dup_count = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
df_dup_count = df_dup_count[df_dup_count > 1]
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (re-tests): {len(df_dup_count)}')

# Check if any patient_id has sample_seq > 1
print(f'Patients with sample_seq > 1: {df[df["sample_seq"] > 1]["patient_id"].nunique()}')"}
